description: Source code for passphrase management, including functions for setting passphrases, changing passwords, and handling password entries in a file, with some NIS integration.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the program; parses command-line arguments and initiates passphrase setting.

methods.name: doit
methods.description: Handles the process of setting a passphrase for a user, including verification and updating the password file.

methods.name: t_changepw
methods.description: Changes the password in the password file, creating backups and optionally renaming files.

methods.name: t_makepwent
methods.description: Creates a new password entry with SRP parameters based on user credentials.

methods.name: t_pwcopy
methods.description: Copies password entries from one file to another, with optional modification.

methods.name: t_getpwent
methods.description: Retrieves the next password entry from the input stream, supporting NIS integration.

methods.name: t_putpwent
methods.description: Writes a password entry to a file in base64-encoded format.
